timelineEvents.title: Birth
timelineEvents.label: 5 Feb 1902 · Birth in Warsaw
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Born in Warsaw to Szmul Moszek Kaper and Maria Mucha, in a Jewish family registered in the city’s non-Christian civil records.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Bronisław Kaper was born in Warsaw on 23 January (5 February, New Style) 1902. His father, Szmul Moszek Kaper, later known as Stanisław or Samuel, was a 28-year-old bookkeeper; his mother, Maria (Mariam) née Mucha, was 24. The Jewish family was registered at the Office of Civil Status for Non-Christian Confessions in Warsaw’s 8th Jerusalem District.

places.publicNote: Sienna 44 is associated with Kaper’s birthplace in Warsaw. The coordinates indicate the address area; exact continuity between the 1902 property and the modern address point remains unverified.
